title: Core modular zero test
statement: Let $C$ be an arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs and let $r$ be a finite Boolean string. For every trial index $j$ among the number of trials determined by the size of $C$, evaluate $C$ modulo the test modulus obtained from the portion of $r$ after its first $n$ input blocks, at the test point obtained from those first blocks. The value must be zero in the corresponding residue class ring.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is an arithmetic circuit on $n$ inputs
The condition holds for every $j$ among the trials determined by $C$'s size
The test point is computed from the prefix of length $n$ times the input block length
The modulus is computed from the remaining suffix of $r$
caveat: The definitions of the block encoding, trial count, and circuit evaluation are not included; the statement can only be described in terms of those constructions.
